messages:
Tao Li: quick sync — need a small seed run comparing A100 / H100 / L40S for our 'trio' model (8k ctx). aim: spot any p99 micro-regressions after the kernel change. can someone kick off?
Maria Gomez: I can run it tonight. what batch sizes you want? tiny (1), med (4), and 8?
Tao Li: yep 1/4/8. keep warm cache and cold cache shards separate. please tag runs with seed=42 and seed=99. want pairwise diffs and a p99 table.
Henry Park: recommend n=50 samples per config for p99 stability. if time-limited, do 20 for initial pass then ramp. also capture GPU power/thermal.
Ash Patel: fyi make sure the L40S run uses the same driver stack as the A100 machines (we had a mismatch last month). ping infra if not.
Maria Gomez: noted. I'll use images: rwinf/trio-bench:2026-03-01 and rwinf/bench-utils:stable. infra, can you confirm drivers on l40s pool? @Ash Patel
bench-bot: infra-check: l40s-pool driver 535.54, a100-pool driver 535.54, h100-pool driver 535.54 — all good.
Maria Gomez: awesome. starting runs now (seed=42 first). command:```
./run_trio_bench --model trio-8k --gpu {A100,H100,L40S} --batch-sizes 1,4,8 --samples 20 --seed 42 --cache warm,cold --output s3://rwinf-bench/trio/seed42/
```
Maria Gomez: kicking off H100 -> A100 -> L40S in that order so infra load evens out. will post summary when done.
Tao Li: cool. capture nvlink/mem bw if available. add perf counters: L2_hit_rate, dram_bw.
Maria Gomez: added perf counters.
bench-bot: run-started: h100-01 (2350012352), a100-03 (2350012390), l40s-02 (2350012425) — logs streaming to s3://rwinf-bench/trio/seed42/logs/.
Henry Park: optional: run with tiny-batch-only cache-disabled for one quick sanity to rule out KV cache effects.
Maria Gomez: good call — will add an extra cold-only quick run after seeds complete.
Maria Gomez: (later) quick preliminary numbers — seed42, batch=1: p50/p95/p99 (ms):
- H100: 18 / 42 / 78
- A100: 20 / 50 / 95
- L40S: 22 / 55 / 110
these are with warm cache. will upload full artifact. seems p99 gap larger on L40S for batch1.
Dev QA: can you attach the diff plot later? want per-token slope too.
Maria Gomez: uploading artifacts now: s3://rwinf-bench/trio/seed42/summary.json and s3://rwinf-bench/trio/seed42/plots/p99-diff.png
bench-bot: artifact-uploaded: summary.json (sha256: b1d3...), plots compressed at s3://rwinf-bench/trio/seed42/plots.zip
Tao Li: nice. Maria can you run seed99 quick for batch1 only on L40S to confirm it's not a noisy seed?
Maria Gomez: started seed99 batch1 on l40s-02 (2350012500).
bench-bot: run-complete: seed42 full sweep. summary: p99 deltas (relative to H100) — A100 +21%, L40S +40% (batch1, warm). detailed: s3://rwinf-bench/trio/seed42/summary.json
Maria Gomez: seed99 result (batch1 cold): L40S p99 = 112 ms, matches seed42 direction. so likely a platform/kernel characteristic, not just seed noise.
Henry Park: can you capture kernel fallback logs? look for warnings about aten/cuda kernels or small-block paths.
Maria Gomez: grep logs:```
cat logs/l40s-02/kernel.log | grep -i "fallback\|quant\|kernel"
# shows a few 'ephemeral fallback to generic_gemm' entries around step ~134
```
Ash Patel: that's the hint — fallback path for small-batch matmul on l40s. filing infra ticket to check vendor kernel compatibility.
Tao Li: great triage. next steps: 1) infra investigates kernel mismatches, 2) eng-runtime to try alternative kernel selection flag (--use-optimized-gemm) on L40S to validate, 3) if fixes not possible, we document a perf note for L40S at small batch.
Dev QA: I can add a dashboard for p99 by batch/gpu and a regression alert on +15% vs H100. file the jira?
Tao Li: please create JIRA RW-ENG-3492 for follow-ups, link artifacts.
Dev QA: done — RW-ENG-3492 created and linked to s3 artifacts.
Maria Gomez: thanks all — will run the --use-optimized-gemm flag in the morning and post results. :thumbsup:
Tao Li: ack, leaving this thread open for results.
